# Digestive Diary

> A non-judgmental digestive health logging app. Not medical advice.

Digestive Diary helps people log food, symptoms, sleep, stress, and experiments to notice personal patterns over time.

## Key pages

- Today (home): /
- Timeline: /timeline
- Insights: /insights
- Settings: /settings
- Help & FAQ: /help
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## Features

- Food and symptom logging with optional voice input
- Pattern insights from your own data only
- Doctor-friendly PDF export
- Optional Google sign-in with Supabase cloud sync
- English and Greek (el) locales

## Important

This app does not provide medical diagnoses or treatment recommendations.
